'''Ross Lillie''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Texas State Championship]] on 6 May 2000 with Throne Room Inserts, according to Matt Lush's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d687">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-07-texas-state-champs-or-how-i-got-robbedd687/ texas-state-champs-or-how-i-got-robbed], DeckTech (Matt "Old Skooler" Lush, 7 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-07-texas-state-champs-or-how-i-got-robbedd687/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
